entries.what: Walks to Flats High on Vinca for a normal Monday, then eats lunch in Ms. Tolentino's room B12 with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Got through the day without running into Brianna's table.

entries.what: Third-period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino; Dulce does the mole calculations fast but stalls on the lab conclusion.
entries.outcome: Math done early, writing left for later.

entries.what: Dinner with her mom Yesenia at unit 114 in Marisol Gardens, then geometry homework before bed.
entries.outcome: Finished homework and slept around 11:30.

entries.what: School day: geometry first, then chemistry, then B12 lunch with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Eli shared his chem notes again.

entries.what: Stops at Cloud Nine Tea Bar after school and buys herself a taro slush with extra pearls, passing on treating the others.
entries.outcome: Kept the spend to one drink.

entries.what: Chats with Karina late in the evening about nothing in particular before bed.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep a bit past midnight.

entries.what: Walks to school and sits through English and world history; Gloria's office is quiet and the laundry room card machine is still down.
entries.outcome: Plain midweek day.

entries.what: B12 lunch with Karina and Eli; Eli plays a bass line on his knee while they trade chem answers.
entries.outcome: Easy lunch, nobody mentioned Brianna.

entries.what: Evening at home doing homework while Yesenia cooks; she pulls the cracked phone off the charger twice because the battery is dying.
entries.outcome: Reminds herself to check the phone fund.

entries.what: In chemistry, Dulce realizes she keeps looking over at Eli when he laughs at something in lab, and that she has a crush on him.
entries.outcome: Noticed the crush and told nobody.

entries.what: Back home that evening she tells the assistant about the crush, then quickly changes the subject to geometry homework.
entries.outcome: Got the geometry problems done and dropped the topic.

entries.what: Lunch in B12 beforehand with Karina and Eli, acting normal.
entries.outcome: Nobody noticed anything.

entries.what: School all day, then takes the 22 bus down Calle Ortega to Taquería Colima for her 4-9 Friday shift.
entries.outcome: Arrived on time.

entries.what: Takes orders at the counter with Camila and Héctor; Efraín lets her count the drawer at close.
entries.outcome: Drawer matched to the penny.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up after the 9 p.m. close and drives her home to Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Home before 10, chatting the whole way.

entries.what: Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room at Marisol Gardens while Yesenia works a half day.
entries.outcome: Two loads folded.

entries.what: Hears that Tío Oscar's stand has moved into its permanent Ruel Road gas station lot spot, starting tonight, Thursday to Sunday evenings.
entries.outcome: Plans to drop by the stand soon.

entries.what: Evening with Karina watching videos and making an edit she never posts.
entries.outcome: Saved the edit to drafts.

entries.what: Sunday shift at Taquería Colima 10-4, ringing up the lunch crowd.
entries.outcome: Busy but smooth shift.

entries.what: Takes the bus home after work, eating the free quesadilla she saved.
entries.outcome: Home by 5.

entries.what: Evening catching up on homework at unit 114 and getting ready for school; Karina texts after midnight.
entries.outcome: Reassured Karina and fell asleep late.
